name: tinnox-cms
description: TINNOX CMS prototype M0: browser-first digital signage content management (internal engineering prototype)

scripts.infra:up: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile worker up -d --build --wait postgres keycloak mailpit media-worker
scripts.dev: npm run infra:up && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,portal,player "npm run dev -w @tinnox/api" "npm run dev -w @tinnox/portal" "npm run dev -w @tinnox/player-web"
scripts.start:built: npm run infra:up && npm run build && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,portal,player "npm run start -w @tinnox/api" "npm run preview -w @tinnox/portal" "npm run preview -w @tinnox/player-web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.json
